def find_conflicts(sessions: Sequence[Session]) -> List[Tuple[Session, Session]]:
    """Return every pair of sessions that clash (same room or group, overlapping time).

    A conflict occurs only when sessions are on the same day, their time intervals
    truly overlap (touching end/start does not count), and they share a room or a
    student group. Each conflicting pair is returned exactly once, ordered by the
    sessions' positions in the input list (i.e., the first element of the tuple
    appears earlier in the list than the second).
    """
    conflicts: List[Tuple[Session, Session]] = []
    # Only consider each unordered pair once (i < j) to avoid duplicates.
    for i, a in enumerate(sessions):
        for b in sessions[i + 1 :]:
            # Sessions must be on the same day.
            if a.day != b.day:
                continue
            # Time intervals must overlap with positive length.
            if not (
                a.start_minutes < b.end_minutes and b.start_minutes < a.end_minutes
            ):
                continue
            # Shared resource (room or at least one common group).
            if _shares_resource(a, b):
                conflicts.append((a, b))
    return conflicts
